sentences.text: Health visitor Bethan Lloyd (S1) identified herself as the health visitor and noted a previous phone conversation on Friday.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) stated the home environment is messy due to having a twelve-day-old baby, Ruby.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) confirmed Ruby is the baby present.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported breastfeeding mostly, but uses one bottle of formula at night because she is tired.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported feeding frequency is every two to two and a half hours during the day, with cluster feeding in the evening.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported having six or seven wet nappies.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported her stitches are sore but better.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported the baby weighed three point four one kilos.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported Ruby sleeps in a Moses basket next to their bed on her back.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported her mood is 'up and down' and she cries a lot.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported her sister, Kirsty, says crying is normal.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) disclosed that Dean pushed her into a wardrobe door during an argument.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported Dean has pushed her three or four times since the summer.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) disclosed that in August, when she was about thirty weeks pregnant, Dean punched her in the stomach.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported she went to the hospital the day after the punching incident because the baby was not moving much, but the baby was fine.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported the punching incident happened just once.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported Dean checks her phone every night and goes through all her messages.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported Dean gets angry if she messages someone he does not like.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported Dean will not let her see her mother, calling her a 'bad influence'.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported she last saw her mother in September, before Ruby was born, and her mother has not met Ruby.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) denied that Dean has ever hurt or been rough with Ruby.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported she feels safe at home today because Dean is at work until three.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported she is at home with her husband, Dean, who works early shifts at a warehouse and is back at three o'clock.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported the relationship with Dean is 'fine' but 'normal' and 'bit tense with no sleep'.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported Dean deals with money and she has applied for child benefit but does not have her own bank card.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported Ruby's birth was registered last Tuesday.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) reported she will provide the number for her sister, Kirsty, for the GP six-week check appointment.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) confirmed she would like the health visitor to refer her to Harbridge Women's Aid.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) requested that the safeguarding referral details not be posted in a letter to the house.
Kayleigh Morris (S2) confirmed she would call 999 if she is ever in danger.
